inputs.name: auditCurlyFunctions.path
inputs.description: Repository path of the audited file, copied unchanged into the path field of every finding it returns. The function never opens this path; it only labels the findings.

inputs.name: auditCurlyFunctions.lines
inputs.description: Source lines of the audited file in file order, scanned once to find brace-delimited blocks; the reported line of a block is its first line's zero-based index plus one. An empty array returns no findings, and a block that has not closed by the last line is dropped without a finding.

inputs.name: auditCurlyFunctions.startsFunction
inputs.description: Predicate called on each line while no block is open; the first line for which it returns true opens a block and is included in that block. Lines inside an open block are never tested, so a match nested inside a block is not reported as a separate block.

inputs.name: auditCurlyFunctions.limits
inputs.description: Defaults to harnessRuleLimits: maxFunctionLines 55, maxParameters 4, maxComplexity 10 and maxNestingDepth 4. This function reads only those four fields; a block is reported when its line count, parameter count, complexity or nesting depth is greater than the matching field, and maxFileLines, maxClassLines, maxMethodLines and maxClassesPerFile are ignored.

inputs.name: auditIndentedPythonBlocks.path
inputs.description: Repository path of the audited Python file, copied unchanged into the path field of every finding it returns. The function never opens this path; it only labels the findings.

inputs.name: auditIndentedPythonBlocks.lines
inputs.description: Source lines of the audited Python file in file order. A line that starts with optional whitespace, then def, whitespace and a word opens a block that ends before the next non-blank line indented no deeper than that def line; lines such as async def are never matched.

inputs.name: auditIndentedPythonBlocks.limits
inputs.description: Defaults to harnessRuleLimits: maxFunctionLines 55, maxParameters 4, maxComplexity 10 and maxNestingDepth 4. This function reads only those four fields; a def block is reported when its line count, parameter count, complexity or nesting depth is greater than the matching field, and maxFileLines, maxClassLines, maxMethodLines and maxClassesPerFile are ignored.

outputs.name: auditCurlyFunctions
outputs.description: One AuditFinding is returned for each exceeded limit of each detected curly-brace block, in block order, so one block can yield up to four findings with the rules small-function, max-parameters, max-complexity and max-nesting. Every finding copies the path argument, and its message names the 1-based line where the block starts; an empty array means no block exceeded a limit.

examples.message: Block starting near line 14 has 61 lines. Limit is 55.
Block starting near line 38 has 6 parameters. Limit is 4.
Block starting near line 38 has complexity 13. Limit is 10.

outputs.name: auditIndentedPythonBlocks
outputs.description: One AuditFinding is returned for each exceeded limit of each line that opens a def block, in line order, so nested defs are reported as separate blocks and one block can yield up to four findings with the rules small-function, max-parameters, max-complexity and max-nesting. Every finding copies the path argument, and an empty array means no def block exceeded a limit.

examples.message: Block starting near line 22 has 5 nested levels. Limit is 4.
Block starting near line 1 has 58 lines. Limit is 55.
